arxiv-2102-10456.title: Decaying Clipping Range in Proximal Policy Optimization
arxiv-2102-10456.creator: Mónika Farsang, Dr. Luca Szegletes
arxiv-2102-10456.description: Abstract Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO) is among the most widely used algorithms in reinforcement learning, which achieves state-of-the-art performance in many challenging problems. The keys to its success are the reliable policy updates through the clipping mechanism and the multiple epochs of minibatch updates. The aim of this research is to give new simple but effective alternatives to the former.

arxiv-2204-09767.title: Classical results for alternating virtual links
arxiv-2204-09767.creator: Hans U. Boden, Homayun Karimi
arxiv-2204-09767.description: Abstract . We extend some classical results of Bankwitz, Crowell, and Murasugi to the setting of virtual links. For instance, we show that an alternating virtual link is split if and only if it is visibly split, and that the Alexander polynomial of any almost classical alternating virtual link is alternating.

arxiv-2205-03603.title: Majorana vortex modes in spin-singlet chiral superconductors with noncollinear spin ordering: Local density of states study
arxiv-2205-03603.creator: A. O. Zlotnikov
arxiv-2205-03603.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by A. O. Zlotnikov. In the present study topologically nontrivial edge and vortex bound states are described in the coexistence phase of chiral spin-singlet superconductivity and noncollinear spin ordering on a triangular lattice in the presence of few (up to four) vortices. We consider the topological phase transition induced by the magnetic order between the phase hosting Majorana modes and the initial phase of the chiral d-wave superconductivity supporting non-Majorana modes which is also topologically nontrivial.

arxiv-2208-03747.title: Rogue waves in the massive Thirring model Journal: ******
arxiv-2208-03747.creator: Junchao Chen, Bo Yang, Bao-Feng Feng
arxiv-2208-03747.description: Abstract In this paper, general rogue wave solutions in the massive Thirring (MT) model are derived by using the Kadomtsev-Petviashvili (KP) hierarchy reduction method and these rational solutions are presented explicitly in terms of determinants whose matrix elements are elementary Schur polynomials.

arxiv-2304-03526.title: Lift3D: Synthesize 3D Training Data by Lifting 2D GAN to 3D Generative Radiance Field
arxiv-2304-03526.creator: Leheng Li 1 Qing Lian 2 Luozhou Wang 1 Ningning Ma 3 Ying-Cong Chen 1,2 1 HKUST(GZ) 2 HKUST 3 NIO Autonomous Driving
arxiv-2304-03526.description: Abstract This work explores the use of 3D generative models to synthesize training data for 3D vision tasks. The key requirements of the generative models are that the generated data should be photorealistic to match the real-world scenarios, and the corresponding 3D attributes should be aligned with given sampling labels.

arxiv-2405-05571.description: Abstract Treewidth on undirected graphs is known to have many algorithmic applications. When considering directed width-measures there are much less results on their deployment for algorithmic results. In 2022 the first author, Rabinovich and Wiederrecht introduced a new directed width measure, 𝒮 → \vec{\mathcal{S}}{} -DAG-width, using directed separations and obtained a structural duality for it. In 2012 Berwanger et al.

arxiv-2412-18267.title: NoiseHGNN: Synthesized Similarity Graph-Based Neural Network For Noised Heterogeneous Graph Representation Learning
arxiv-2412-18267.creator: Xiong Zhang, Cheng Xie Haoran Duan, Beibei Yu
arxiv-2412-18267.description: Abstract Real-world graph data environments intrinsically exist noise (e.g., link and structure errors) that inevitably disturb the effectiveness of graph representation and downstream learning tasks. For homogeneous graphs, the latest works use original node features to synthesize a similarity graph that can correct the structure of the noised graph.

arxiv-2504-14591.title: Kinetic Theory of Quasiparticles, Retarded Correlators and Hydrodynamics
arxiv-2504-14591.creator: Ali Hataei, Roya Heydari, Farid Taghinavaz
arxiv-2504-14591.description: Abstract Kinetic theory provides a powerful framework for investigating macroscopic and microscopic properties of weakly and strongly interacting plasmas. By assuming a constant mass profile within the kinetic theory approach, we examine the collective behavior of a system of massive relativistic particles within the Maxwell-Boltzmann equilibrium distribution.

arxiv-2508-08349.title: DiffractGPT: Atomic Structure Determination from X-ray Diffraction Patterns using Generative Pre-trained Transformer
arxiv-2508-08349.creator: Kamal Choudhary
arxiv-2508-08349.description: Abstract Crystal structure determination from powder diffraction patterns is a complex challenge in materials science, often requiring extensive expertise and computational resources. This study introduces DiffractGPT, a generative pre-trained transformer model designed to predict atomic structures directly from X-ray diffraction (XRD) patterns. By capturing the intricate relationships between diffraction patterns and crystal structures, DiffractGPT enables fast and accurate inverse design.

Within this group the polybrominated diphenyl ethers (PBDE) constitute one class of many that are found in electrical appliances, building materials, and textiles. PBDEs are persistent compounds...

pmc-11374109.title: Role of Magnetic Resonance Spectroscopy in Evaluating Choline Levels in Gallbladder Carcinoma: A Comprehensive Review
pmc-11374109.creator: Anjali Kumari, Gaurav Mishra, Pratapsingh Parihar, Sakshi S Dudhe
pmc-11374109.description: Gallbladder carcinoma (GBC) presents a significant clinical challenge due to its aggressive nature and often asymptomatic progression, resulting in late-stage diagnoses and a poor prognosis. Early detection and accurate staging are pivotal for improving patient outcomes, highlighting the critical role of advanced imaging techniques in oncological practice.

pmc-11514000.title: Decoding the impact of the placebo response in clinical trials for chronic cough
pmc-11514000.creator: Mengru Zhang, Bangyu Zhang, Alyn H. Morice
pmc-11514000.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Chronic cough is a prevalent and challenging condition, with limited treatment options available. The interpretation of clinical trial results for antitussive drugs is complicated by the presence of the placebo response, which can confound outcomes and impede regulatory approval. This review aims to explore the impact of the placebo response on clinical trials for cough medications and elucidate the underlying mechanisms involved. The multifaceted nature of antitussive effects, including pharmacological, psychological/neurobiological and nonspecific effects, is discussed.

pmc-11603481.title: The Use of Autologous Omentum Transposition as a Therapeutic Intervention to Reduce the Complication of Ischemia/Reperfusion Injuries in a Rat Model
pmc-11603481.creator: Amirreza Shamshirgaran, Abdolreza Mohammadi, Parisa Zahmatkesh, Gholamreza Mesbah, Fateme Guitynavard, Zahra Saffarian, Alireza Khajavi, Leonardo Oliveira Reis, Seyed Mohammad Kazem Aghamir
pmc-11603481.description: Background:Ischemia/reperfusion injury (IRI) causes cellular dysfunction and death in organs like the kidney, heart, and brain. It involves energy depletion during ischemia and oxidative stress, inflammation, and apoptosis during reperfusion. Kidney IRI often leads to acute kidney injury (AKI) in various clinical scenarios. The omentum, an adipose tissue with healing properties, has been used to treat injuries in different organs.

pmc-11625351.title: Metabolic stress in space: ROS-induced mutations in mice hint at a new path to cancer
pmc-11625351.creator: Viktor Stolc, Miloslav Karhanek, Friedemann Freund, Yuri Griko, David J. Loftus, Maurice M. Ohayon
pmc-11625351.description: Long-duration spaceflight beyond Earth's magnetosphere poses serious health risks, including muscle atrophy, bone loss, liver and kidney damage, and the Spaceflight-Associated Neuro-ocular Syndrome (SANS). RNA-seq of mice aboard the International Space Station (ISS) for 37 days revealed extraordinary hypermutation in tissue-specific genes, with guanine base conversion predominating, potentially contributing to spaceflight-associated health risks.

pmc-11653826.title: Human resource management in homecare in England: managing people for safe care during crisis
pmc-11653826.creator: Thoai Le, Simon Bishop, Carl Macrae
pmc-11653826.description: BackgroundHuman resource management (HRM) of healthcare organisations plays an important role in improving the continuity of care, managing staff, and ensuring patient safety. During COVID-19, there were several HR-related issues, creating a significant challenging situation for health and social care institutions.

pmc-12580851.title: Sustained remission with eculizumab in refractory lupus nephritis with atypical haemolytic uraemic syndrome
pmc-12580851.creator: Brady Thomson, Kathleen Nicholls
pmc-12580851.description: SummaryLupus nephritis (LN) is a severe manifestation of systemic lupus erythematosus with approximately 50% of patients having renal involvement. Patients who fail to respond to appropriate induction immunosuppression are considered to have refractory disease. Refractory LN is associated with increased risk of progression to end-stage chronic kidney disease and mortality.

pmc-12678628.title: Efficacy and safety of repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation in youth with depression: a systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized sham-controlled trials
pmc-12678628.creator: Yu-Jie Tao, Xiao-Xia Duan, Pei Liu, Mei-Wen Wang, Si-Xun Li, Ting-Ting Luo, Hao-Yang Xing, Yi Huang
pmc-12678628.description: BackgroundMajor depressive disorder is a major cause of disability and health-related burden globally. Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) has emerged as a promising alternative therapy for major depressive disorder in adults, but its efficacy and safety in 10–25 years (youth) with depression remains inconclusive.

pmc-13159250.title: Deciphering the genomic landscape of hypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae in South African tertiary hospitals
pmc-13159250.creator: Ayavuya T Papiyana, Jolly Musoke, Likhona Dingiswayo, Olusesan A Adelabu, Zothile T Skosana
pmc-13159250.description: BackgroundHypervirulent Klebsiella pneumoniae (hvKp) is an emerging pathogen causing severe infections globally, yet genomic data from inland South African regions remain limited, hindering understanding of local hvKp diversity and virulence.MethodsElevenhypermucoviscous Klebsiella pneumoniae isolates collected in 2021 and 2024 were subjected to WGS.

pmc-13401289.title: Evaluating performance and potential clinical benefit of the Swedish On Scene Injury Severity Prediction (OSISP) model for prehospital field triage on Norwegian trauma data
pmc-13401289.creator: Anna Bakidou, Eva-Corina Caragounis, Magnus Andersson Hagiwara, Olav Røise, Anders Jonsson, Bengt Arne Sjöqvist, Stefan Candefjord

pmc-13415921.title: Record-low 2025 and 2026 ice extents restore Arctic winter sea-ice decline
pmc-13415921.creator: Duo Chan, Alessandro Silvano, Simon A. Josey
pmc-13415921.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Recent analyses have suggested that the decadal rate of Arctic winter sea-ice extent decline weakened in the early 2020s, with 20-y trends becoming statistically insignificant. Here we show from more up-to-date observations that the exceptionally low 2025 and 2026 ice extent winters reversed this picture, with sea-ice extent during the growth and peak phases returning to record lows and 20-y decline trends becoming significant again.

pmc-13468833.title: The significance of the ketolytic gene OXCT1 in metabolism, intracellular signaling and disease development
pmc-13468833.creator: Karolina Górecka, Kamila Soboska, Marcin Pacholczyk, Luciano Pirola, Aneta Balcerczyk
pmc-13468833.description: OXCT1 (3-oxoacid CoA-transferase 1), encoding the mitochondrial enzyme SCOT (succinyl-CoA:3-ketoacid CoA transferase), is a key enzyme in ketone body utilization. It catalyzes the reversible transfer of CoA from succinyl-CoA to acetoacetate, generating acetoacetyl-CoA, which is subsequently converted into acetyl-CoA for entry into the tricarboxylic acid (TCA) cycle and mitochondrial energy production.

pmc-13614995.title: Head Acceleration Magnitude in Sport-Related Concussive Impacts: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis
pmc-13614995.creator: Branimir Ivanic, Anna Cronström, Mana Rasi, Eva Ageberg
pmc-13614995.description: BackgroundSport-related concussion (SRC) is a common and complex injury in athletic populations. Linear head acceleration (LHA) and rotational head acceleration (RHA) are key biomechanical factors believed to contribute to SRC, each through distinct mechanisms. Evaluating head impact magnitudes across different sports, athlete populations, and measurement methods is essential for advancing SRC injury prevention and risk assessment.

pmc-13680428.title: Climate urgency enables political alignment for Latin American power integration
pmc-13680428.creator: Luis Ramírez, Gerardo Blanco, Felipe Sepulveda, Luiz Barroso, Wilfredo C Flores, Rodrigo Moreno
pmc-13680428.description: Political fragmentation continues to block urgently needed power integration in Latin America, despite the region’s vast renewable energy potential. Using the Multiple Streams Approach, this study argues that the escalating climate crisis now acts as a focusing event, aligning a pressing energy problem, viable integration solutions, and growing political will. This alignment signals that a policy window is open.
